 On October 27, 2026, Sonnenhof Großaspach and Augsburg will meet in the round of 32 of the German Cup . The visitors should be able to handle such an opponent, although the hosts have already managed to spring a surprise.
 Sonnenhof Großaspach vs Augsburg team news and expert analysis
 The club from Gadebut only secured promotion from the regional division this spring. It is now fighting to retain its place in the 3. Liga, where it has looked weak but not hopeless. In the most recent round, however, it suffered a truly humiliating defeat to Wehen, losing 1-7.
 The Bavarian side finished last spring in ninth place, right in the middle of the table, with 43 points. It has made a respectable start to the current campaign, losing only to Werder. Augsburg even shared the points with Bayern! It subsequently lost to debutants Elversberg and drew 1-1 with Union.
 The underdog caused a surprise in August by knocking out Arminia. The match ended 2-2 before Sonnenhof Großaspach prevailed in the penalty shootout. Their opponents, meanwhile, played away from home and comfortably defeated Energie 2-0 in Cottbus.
 Previous matches: Sonnenhof Großaspach vs Augsburg 
 This is the kind of away side that will arrive in Aspach.
 Augsburg finally has a chance to give its fans something to celebrate. We are backing them with a -1.5-goal handicap (odds – 1.86).
